transitions.statement: Stress proxy -> physiologically defined stress target
Heterogeneous five-season archive -> explicit common-variable/missingness design
Internal fit -> blocked unseen-year validation -> independent commercial-field validation
Leaf/proximal sensing -> ELTE hyperspectral/UAV bridge -> Sentinel-2 field-scale operational inputs
Standalone model -> continuously developed DrR web MVP -> AgroVIR industrial evaluation
Academic-only validation -> farmer-facing real-world test plus a defined post-MSCA Bulgarian replication route through MVCRI
Tomato-specific prototype -> crop-configurable high-value-horticulture framework with explicit crop-specific validation/calibration gates

Project logic in one chain: MATE longitudinal evidence -> physiological stress definition -> HUN-REN modelling and uncertainty -> ELTE proximal/UAV/Sentinel scale bridging -> independent commercial-farmer validation -> validated crop module -> Krumatic software implementation -> DrR web MVP -> AgroVIR operational/FMIS evaluation -> post-MSCA Bulgarian replication and additional crop modules.

outcomes.statement: A physiologically defined water-stress target with a harmonised, QC-controlled five-season evidence base, replacing spectral-proxy stress definitions.
outcomes.note: Derived: TR1/TR2 state the intended change of state; D1.1/D1.2 are the outputs whose content brings it about.

outcomes.statement: A parsimonious, interpretable, uncertainty-aware predictive framework whose reusable components are explicitly separated from crop-specific parameters, with a documented crop-transfer specification.
outcomes.note: Derived: the scale bridge (TR4) and crop-configurability (TR7) are realised by the model card and the harmonisation/crop-transfer specification.

outcomes.statement: Quantified real-world transferability: the transfer gap from research experiments to an independent commercial field measured prospectively, with uncertainty and any limited recalibration stated.
outcomes.note: Derived: TR3 names the validation ladder; D3.1/D3.2 are the dataset and report that quantify it.

outcomes.statement: A research-to-operation delivery path: a crop-configurable web MVP carrying the validated tomato module, industrially evaluated by AgroVIR, with a named post-MSCA FMIS-integration and exploitation route and a Bulgarian replication route through MVCRI.
outcomes.source_ref: Pack §1.1.9 arrows 5-6; §3.1 D4.1-D5.2; Pack Appendix B
outcomes.note: Derived: TR5/TR6 name the operational and replication transitions; the four outputs realise them. The Pack bounds this outcome: the MVP supports decisions rather than automatically controlling irrigation, and any new crop requires a defined validation/calibration step before operational use.

outcomes.statement: A researcher profile consolidated as an Agricultural Data Scientist specialised in plant stress, Earth observation and decision support, carried by an agreed and reviewed Career Development Plan and the inter-sectoral placement.
outcomes.source_ref: Pack §1.4, §2.1; DI item 14; operator input pack item 6
